pr_title: Upgrade jest to improve the test duration

comments.body:
Stylelint current warns deprecation `declaration-property-unit-whitelist` and prefers `declaration-property-unit-allowed-list`. 
But to update this we will need to update upstream first at package `stylelint-config-cm`, otherwise neither rule gets applied.
Fix `app/js/src/app/contacts/hostedsubscribeform/components/PrivacyBlock/PrivacyBlock.tsx` importing and using the wrong type `CheckboxProps`

There are multiple of these below. 
`FindByText` or `FindByRole('button', ...` returning the elements inside the `button` tag that we want but not the `button` tag themselves. 
This causes `expect(element).toBeDisabled();` checks to always fail which is problematic.

Fix `ReferenceError: regeneratorRuntime is not defined` in `js/src/app/account/accountdetails/CloseAccount/CloseAccount.spec.tsx` only. 
No idea why it's happening in only that test file, even though there are other test files using async await 🤷

Breaking change. 
Square brackets and brackets now needs to be escaped `[` --> `[[`

Fix type checker going wonky and using the node.js type defs for setTimeout. 
We want return type `number` and not `NodeJS.Timer`

Fix `sendApiUpdate` not getting mocked in test. 

This wasn't immediately obvious to me but if we intend to mock `sendApiUpdate` in tests like this: 
![image](https://git.campmon.com/storage/user/367/files/041e9b80-f129-11eb-9b41-b92d1387b6e2)
then we need to make sure we are importing `sendApiUpdate` from the same file that we are mocking.

Missing `await` on `waitFor` call. 

This one was annoying to find because the error 
![image](https://git.campmon.com/storage/user/367/files/db4ad600-f129-11eb-97c2-9b804e8b1ed4)
comes up 10 (random number) test suites later with no stack trace.

Jest 27 breaking change 
https://jestjs.io/blog/2020/05/05/jest-26#new-fake-timers

We use legacy timers to mock `setTimeout`
